audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls the pillar his E ('E pillar', 'fires E pillar at you') and the charge his W ('W brittle-ram'). Both slots are wrong.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture (Q, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, 800 range) is the fissure that leaves the magma pillar. Searing Charge (E, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, 450 range) is the charge, and it only knocks up if Ornn collides with terrain. Bellows Breath (W) is the flame that applies Brittle — it is not a ram.
audit.corrected: Pillar = Q, charge/knockup = E and only into terrain, Brittle = W. The practical consequence: fight away from walls and away from his own pillar, because the pillar is the terrain he charges you into.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and 2+ items were scored Lucian while whys[4] says his R 'offsets' your all-in and whys[6] says he reclaims the lane outright.
audit.why: 45.04% win rate over a large sample and the packet chart gives Ornn the last stage and calls 4-6 neutral. Call of the Forge God (140/120/100s) knocks up twice and applies Brittle; Living Forge lets him out-item you.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] and phases[6] described Lucian's own curve and never named Ornn's two real spikes.
audit.why: Level 6 is Call of the Forge God; the late spike is Living Forge free itemization, which the content layer already identifies but the level chart did not.
audit.corrected: Both stages now name the Ornn spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged only 1 sequencing cue; every cooldown line said 'count Volcanic Rupture' with no duration.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9s at rank 1 and Searing Charge is 14s — the charge is the long one, and it is the ability that actually kills you, so it is the one worth counting.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into dosFull[0] and dosFull[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit marks Volcanic Rupture with a 'grounding' flag; Riot's description mentions only damage, a slow and the pillar.
audit.why: If it grounded, Relentless Pursuit would be unavailable inside it and half this page's escape advice would change. The description does not support it, so nothing was asserted.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God knocks up twice and applies Brittle — never channel The Culling into it.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Living Forge lets him buy anywhere and out-stat you — a full-tank Ornn cannot be killed 1v1 by your scaling.

edits.before: Your Q double-shot at level 2 chunks him before his W brittle-ram and E pillar are both available to combo back.
edits.after: Your Q double-shot at level 2 chunks him before Bellows Breath and Searing Charge are both up to combo back.

edits.before: Q + Lightslinger double-shot lands a brutal trade before Ornn has both his W brittle-ram and E pillar online.
edits.after: Q + Lightslinger double-shot lands a brutal trade before Ornn has both Bellows Breath and Searing Charge online.

edits.before: Q-W-E gives you poke, an Ardent Blaze speed steroid, and a dash to leave his pillar/ram range whenever you want.
edits.after: Q-W-E gives you poke, an Ardent Blaze speed steroid, and a dash out of his 450-range Searing Charge when you want.

edits.before: Use E (Relentless Pursuit) to dash out the instant he flickers W to charge or fires E pillar at you
edits.after: Use E (Relentless Pursuit) the instant Searing Charge starts — that terrain collision is the knockup

edits.before: Land E pillar then W brittle-ram to combo you into the pillar wall for the slow and knockup
edits.after: Land Volcanic Rupture's pillar, then Searing Charge into it for the knockup and Brittle

edits.before: Pillar + knockup setup — stay off walls and sidestep the line. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture is 9s and its pillar is the wall he charges you into — never fight beside it.

edits.before: Ornn whiffs Volcanic Rupture and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Searing Charge is 14s and needs terrain — fight in the open lane.

edits.before: That is Ornn’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Bellows Breath makes you Brittle — leave before it lands.

notes: The slot mix-up mattered practically, not just cosmetically: the old text told you to dodge the 'E pillar' and respect a 'W ram', which inverts the actual danger — his pillar is terrain he can then charge you into with E for the knockup, so the rule is to stand away from his own pillar, not just away from walls. diff reads HARD while diffRating/breakdown.difficulty/report[14] all say 'Favoured 4/10'; that internal disagreement predates this audit and needs a single deliberate call across four strings.
